episodeTitle.en: LinkedIn’s product evolution and the art of building complex systems | Hari Srinivasan (LinkedIn)
episodeTitle.zh: 领英的产品演进与复杂系统构建之道 | 哈里·斯里尼瓦桑（领英）

guestBioOfficial.en: Hari Srinivasan is VP of Product at LinkedIn Talent Solutions, where he oversees LinkedIn Recruiter, LinkedIn Jobs, and LinkedIn Learning. He’s also a frequent guest lecturer at Stanford University. Previously, he served as the CEO and founder of We Created It, which was acquired by LinkedIn in 2014. Hari has a passion for building products, with experience ranging from creating the first U.S. hybrid SUV to developing a No. 1 app and writing a beloved children’s book. In today’s episode, we discuss: • LinkedIn’s unique business model and org structure
guestBioOfficial.zh: 哈里·斯里尼瓦桑是领英人才解决方案部门的产品副总裁，负责领英招聘、领英招聘和领英学习业务。他还是斯坦福大学的常客讲师。此前，他曾担任We Created It的首席执行官兼创始人，该公司于2014年被领英收购。哈里对产品开发充满热情，其经验涵盖从打造美国首款混合动力SUV到开发头号应用程序，再到撰写深受喜爱的儿童书籍。在今天的节目中，我们讨论了：• 领英独特的商业模式和组织结构

title.en: LinkedIn’s product evolution and the art of building complex systems | Hari Srinivasan (LinkedIn)
title.zh: 领英的产品演进与复杂系统构建之道 | 哈里·斯里尼瓦桑（领英）

summary.en: Hari shares what he's seeing shift in the hiring market—including the rise of skills-first hiring, which translates experience into portable skills to rebalance a frozen labor marketplace—and gives concrete tips to improve your odds of landing a job through LinkedIn. He reflects on lessons from building and maintaining enormously complex systems like LinkedIn, advice for breaking into product management, and how LinkedIn became a source of genuinely valuable (and far less cringe) content over the past couple of years. The episode originated from a spontaneous Twitter request for a LinkedIn insider, and it shows.
summary.zh: Hari 分享了他对招聘市场变化的观察——包括“技能优先招聘”（skills-first hiring）的兴起，即把经历转化为可迁移的技能，以重新平衡冻结的劳动力市场，并给出了通过 LinkedIn 提高求职成功率的实用建议。他回顾了打造与维护 LinkedIn 这类极度复杂系统的经验、进入产品管理的建议，以及 LinkedIn 过去几年如何变成真正有价值（且不再尴尬）的内容来源。这期节目源自一条在 Twitter 上“想请 LinkedIn 内部人来做客”的临时请求，非常有意思。
